what: Discovering and Authenticating with a Bridge
title: Getting Started with huer
text: Locate bridge’s local IP address using hue_discover() (check router / Hue app). Press physical round link button top Hue Bridge. Generate application key (hue-application-key) within 30 seconds: reproducible scripts, set HUE_BRIDGE_IP HUE_APP_KEY environment, create explicit client object hue_bridge(): TLS Note: Local Philips Hue Bridges serve HTTPS using certificate signed Signify Hue Bridge Root CA. strict certificate validation, pass path Signify Root CA PEM file via ca_cert verify_ssl = TRUE; trusted local LANs, verify_ssl = FALSE disables certificate verification.
code: library(huer)  bridges <- hue_discover() ip <- bridges$internalipaddress[[1]]  # Press the physical link button on the Hue Bridge before running: creds <- hue_create_app_key(ip, app_name = "huer")  # Store credentials for the current R session hue_auth(ip = ip, app_key = creds$username[[1]], verify_ssl = FALSE) library(huer)  bridge <- hue_bridge(   ip = "192.168.1.50",   app_key = "example-application-key",   verify_ssl = FALSE ) bridge #>  #> ── Philips Hue Bridge Client (CLIP API v2) #> Bridge: https://192.168.1.50 #> App key: exam...-key #> TLS: unverified (local) #> Timeout: 10s

what: Step 1: Understanding the CLIP API v2 Resource Graph
title: Building a Shiny Hue Controller with huer
text: Philips Hue CLIP API v2, rooms, zones, grouped lights, individual lights, scenes connected via rid / rtype references stored inside nested JSON arrays (children services): room (hue_get_rooms()) lists member hardware devices children (rtype == "device") group light controller services (rtype == "grouped_light"). light (hue_get_lights()) points back parent device via owner.rid. zone (hue_get_zones()) lists member lights directly children (rtype == "light") group controller services (rtype == "grouped_light"). scene (hue_get_scenes()) links room zone via group.rid. huer returns tbl_json objects, hue_unnest_array() resolves relationships single line:
code: library(huer)  sample_room_json <- paste0(   '{"errors":[],"data":[{"id":"room-1","type":"room",',   '"metadata":{"name":"Living Room"},',   '"children":[{"rid":"dev-1","rtype":"device"}],',   '"services":[{"rid":"gl-1","rtype":"grouped_light"}]}]}' )  sample_light_json <- paste0(   '{"errors":[],"data":[{"id":"light-1","type":"light",',   '"owner":{"rid":"dev-1","rtype":"device"},',   '"metadata":{"name":"Floor Lamp"},',   '"on":{"on":true},"dimming":{"brightness":80}}]}' )  rooms <- hue_parse_response(sample_room_json) lights <- hue_parse_response(sample_light_json)  # 1. Resolve the room's grouped_light ID services <- hue_unnest_array(rooms, "services") grouped_light_id <- services$rid[services$rtype == "grouped_light"][[1L]] grouped_light_id #> [1] "gl-1"  # 2. Resolve all lights inside the room (matching both light and device children) children <- hue_unnest_array(rooms, "children") room_lights <- lights[   lights$id %in% children$rid[children$rtype == "light"] |     lights$owner.rid %in% children$rid[children$rtype == "device"],   ,   drop = FALSE ] room_lights[, c("id", "metadata.name", "on.on", "dimming.brightness")] #> # A tibble: 1 × 5 #>   ..JSON                   id      metadata.name on.on dimming.brightness #>   <chr>                    <chr>   <chr>         <lgl>              <dbl> #> 1 "{\"id\":\"light-1\"..." light-1 Floor Lamp    TRUE                  80

what: Step 2: Converting Hex Colors to CIE 1931 xy
title: Building a Shiny Hue Controller with huer
text: Philips Hue lights expect color chromaticity CIE 1931 xy coordinates (hue_payload_light(xy = c(x, y))), whereas HTML5 <input type="color"> controls emit sRGB hex strings like "#ff8800". Add compact helper using base R’s grDevices::col2rgb() Wide RGB D65 matrix recommended Philips Hue: zero-dependency native HTML5 color picker Shiny, wrap <input type="color"> tag pushes updates via Shiny.setInputValue():
code: hex_to_cie_xy <- function(hex) {   rgb <- as.numeric(grDevices::col2rgb(hex)) / 255    # Inverse sRGB gamma companding   lin <- ifelse(     rgb > 0.04045,     ((rgb + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4,     rgb / 12.92   )    # Wide RGB D65 -> CIE XYZ   X <- lin[1] * 0.664511 + lin[2] * 0.154324 + lin[3] * 0.162028   Y <- lin[1] * 0.283881 + lin[2] * 0.668433 + lin[3] * 0.047685   Z <- lin[1] * 0.000088 + lin[2] * 0.072310 + lin[3] * 0.986039    denom <- X + Y + Z   if (denom == 0) return(c(0.3127, 0.3290))    c(round(max(0, min(1, X / denom)), 4),     round(max(0, min(1, Y / denom)), 4)) }  xy <- hex_to_cie_xy("#ff8800") xy #> [1] 0.6010 0.3837  # Ready to pass straight into hue_payload_light() hue_payload_light(on = TRUE, brightness = 80, xy = xy, dynamics_duration = 400) #> $on #> $on$on #> [1] TRUE #>  #>  #> $dimming #> $dimming$brightness #> [1] 80 #>  #>  #> $color #> $color$xy #> $color$xy$x #> [1] 0.601 #>  #> $color$xy$y #> [1] 0.3837 #>  #>  #>  #> $dynamics #> $dynamics$duration #> [1] 400 color_input <- function(inputId, label, value = "#ffcf70") {   tags$div(     class = "mb-3",     tags$label(label, `for` = inputId, class = "form-label d-block"),     tags$input(       id = inputId,       type = "color",       value = value,       class = "form-control form-control-color w-100",       style = "height: 40px; cursor: pointer;",       onchange = sprintf(         "Shiny.setInputValue('%s', this.value, {priority: 'event'})",         inputId       )     )   ) }

what: Step 4: Wiring the Reactive Server Logic
title: Building a Shiny Hue Controller with huer
text: Store hue_bridge client fetched resource tables reactiveValues(). Whenever user connects sends PUT update, call refresh_state() tables, dropdowns, KPI cards reflect bridge’s live state:
code: server <- function(input, output, session) {   rv <- reactiveValues(     bridge = NULL,     rooms = NULL, zones = NULL, lights = NULL,     grouped_lights = NULL, scenes = NULL   )    refresh_state <- function() {     req(rv$bridge)     rv$rooms <- hue_get_rooms(bridge = rv$bridge)     rv$zones <- hue_get_zones(bridge = rv$bridge)     rv$lights <- hue_get_lights(bridge = rv$bridge)     rv$grouped_lights <- hue_get_grouped_lights(bridge = rv$bridge)     rv$scenes <- hue_get_scenes(bridge = rv$bridge)   }    # Bridge discovery (GET https://discovery.meethue.com/)   observeEvent(input$discover_btn, {     found <- hue_discover()     if (nrow(found) > 0L) {       updateTextInput(session, "bridge_ip", value = found$internalipaddress[[1L]])     }   })    # Connect to the local bridge   observeEvent(input$connect_btn, {     rv$bridge <- hue_bridge(       ip = trimws(input$bridge_ip),       app_key = trimws(input$app_key),       verify_ssl = isTRUE(input$verify_ssl)     )     refresh_state()   })    observeEvent(input$refresh_btn, refresh_state())    # Populate room/zone choices   active_groups <- reactive({     req(rv$rooms, rv$zones)     if (identical(input$group_kind, "room")) rv$rooms else rv$zones   })    observe({     grp <- active_groups()     choices <- setNames(grp$id, grp$metadata.name)     updateSelectInput(session, "selected_group", choices = choices)   })    selected_group_row <- reactive({     grp <- active_groups()     req(nzchar(input$selected_group))     grp[grp$id == input$selected_group, , drop = FALSE]   })    # Resolve grouped_light ID for the selected room/zone   selected_grouped_light_id <- reactive({     svcs <- hue_unnest_array(selected_group_row(), "services")     gl <- svcs[svcs$rtype == "grouped_light", , drop = FALSE]     if (nrow(gl) == 0L) NULL else gl$rid[[1L]]   })    # Resolve member lights for the selected room/zone   group_lights <- reactive({     children <- hue_unnest_array(selected_group_row(), "children")     keep <- (rv$lights$id %in% children$rid[children$rtype == "light"]) |       (rv$lights$owner.rid %in% children$rid[children$rtype == "device"])     rv$lights[keep, , drop = FALSE]   })    # Populate individual light & scene dropdowns   observe({     lt <- group_lights()     updateSelectInput(session, "selected_light", choices = setNames(lt$id, lt$metadata.name))   })    observe({     row <- selected_group_row()     sc <- rv$scenes[rv$scenes$group.rid == row$id[[1L]], , drop = FALSE]     updateSelectInput(session, "selected_scene", choices = setNames(sc$id, sc$metadata.name))   })    # Render interactive lights table   output$lights_table <- renderDT({     lt <- group_lights()     datatable(       tibble::tibble(         Name = lt$metadata.name,         State = ifelse(lt$on.on, "ON", "OFF"),         Brightness = round(lt$dimming.brightness, 1)       ),       selection = "single",       rownames = FALSE     )   })    # Group lighting updates (PUT /clip/v2/resource/grouped_light/{id})   observeEvent(input$grp_on_btn, {     hue_update_grouped_light(       selected_grouped_light_id(),       hue_payload_light(on = TRUE, dynamics_duration = input$grp_duration),       bridge = rv$bridge     )     refresh_state()   })    observeEvent(input$grp_off_btn, {     hue_update_grouped_light(       selected_grouped_light_id(),       hue_payload_light(on = FALSE, dynamics_duration = input$grp_duration),       bridge = rv$bridge     )     refresh_state()   })    observeEvent(input$grp_apply_white, {     hue_update_grouped_light(       selected_grouped_light_id(),       hue_payload_light(         on = TRUE,         brightness = input$grp_brightness,         mirek = input$grp_mirek,         dynamics_duration = input$grp_duration       ),       bridge = rv$bridge     )     refresh_state()   })    observeEvent(input$grp_apply_color, {     hue_update_grouped_light(       selected_grouped_light_id(),       hue_payload_light(         on = TRUE,         brightness = input$grp_brightness,         xy = hex_to_cie_xy(input$grp_color),         dynamics_duration = input$grp_duration       ),       bridge = rv$bridge     )     refresh_state()   })    observeEvent(input$grp_apply_effect, {     hue_update_grouped_light(       selected_grouped_light_id(),       hue_payload_light(on = TRUE, effect = input$grp_effect),       bridge = rv$bridge     )     refresh_state()   })    # Scene recall (PUT /clip/v2/resource/scene/{id})   observeEvent(input$scene_recall_active, {     req(nzchar(input$selected_scene))     hue_recall_scene(       id = input$selected_scene,       action = "active",       duration = input$scene_duration,       bridge = rv$bridge     )     refresh_state()   })    # Individual light updates (PUT /clip/v2/resource/light/{id})   observeEvent(input$light_apply_white, {     req(nzchar(input$selected_light))     payload <- if (isTRUE(input$light_on)) {       hue_payload_light(on = TRUE, brightness = input$light_brightness, mirek = input$light_mirek)     } else {       hue_payload_light(on = FALSE)     }     hue_update_light(input$selected_light, payload, bridge = rv$bridge)     refresh_state()   })    observeEvent(input$light_apply_color, {     req(nzchar(input$selected_light))     hue_update_light(       input$selected_light,       hue_payload_light(         on = TRUE,         brightness = input$light_brightness,         xy = hex_to_cie_xy(input$light_color)       ),       bridge = rv$bridge     )     refresh_state()   }) }  shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
